Integrated the product with HubSpot and other business systems to improve funnel

System Design & Architecture
Continuously evolved platform architecture to support scale, reliability, and 
faster delivery cycles. Led the decomposition of a monolithic application into 
15+ independently deployable services, improving performance, deployment 
velocity, fault isolation, and reducing user-facing downtime.
